scope: Completed G1 label-profile comparison from frozen artifacts. No inference, network, image decoding, or live catalogue access.

reference.score_rule: the mean of the best cosine of the wine in each view of the photo; the current items of the index alone

label.score_rule: the mean of the best cosine of the wine in each view of the photo; the current items of the index alone

notes: Use the saved attempts and run artifacts only. No live catalogue or source image was read.
All counts use query rows. The 2228 rows contain 1851 distinct image digests. Repeated bytes and frozen labels remain in the denominators.
Cache hit counts describe recorded step flags. They are not counts of correct barcode answers.
Package alpha paths make no SAM3 request. Missing cache flags are not cache misses.
The embed step batches the available views. The trace has no embedding-cache flag or separate embedding time per tower. Query embedding responses are not cached by this client.
The cluster_rules cache flag describes the VLM response. The inner label-SAM3 cache state is not separately recorded.
Costs use trace.steps[].ms, not candidate.explain.ms. The latter can retain an older cached inference duration.
Stage totals sum concurrent query work. They cannot be added to or subtracted from process wall to predict a new-image response.
Both runs use four workers and enabled caches, but their actual cache hit patterns differ. Their run wall times are not an equal-cache throughput comparison.
Both saved latency distributions have comparable=false. These are bulk observations, not sequential HTTP demo measurements.
A found label rectangle does not prove correct geometry. No image or mask quality inspection occurred.
The added label view changes score aggregation and can change rerank selection. This comparison does not attribute every quality loss to segmentation alone.
A negative label excludes its named wine. An allowed alternative does not prove correct recognition.
